Vision
Kamrup College, Chamata envisions both academic and
professional excellence. With proper consideration for
human values, the college is committed to provide an
abundance of opportunities to students to develop their
interpersonal and leadership abilities in this setting. The
promotion of national unity, harmony, and secularism is
made possible through the comprehensive development
of the individual. Additionally, the college wants to
promote the pursuit of excellence and instill a sense of
civic responsibility in its students. Along with providing
quality education, Kamrup College, Chamata also
provides the students with value-based education that
would help them to uplift themselves along with the
society.




Mission
The mission of the college is to create awareness and
interest for higher education among the people in the
rural proximity, and spread female literacy in particular,
thereby enabling all to lead an enlightened life marked
by all round development of the society. Kamrup
College, Chamata also wants to make itself a key player
in the area by focusing on imparting skills to students for
optimum human resource development, in addition to
creating a platform for meritorious students to aim for
higher pursuits of learning.




 Motto
 To add to one's knowledge, to foster the competitive
 spirit, and to institute a positive societal change.

HUMANITIES
The Arts & Humanities stream at Kamrup College, Chamata has ten
departments dedicated to exploring every aspect of human culture- from
literature, philosophy, and education to history, languages, and polity. The
departments under this stream are -
    • Arabic        • Assamese      • Economics
    • Education     • English       • History
    • Mathematics • Philosophy • Political Science
    • Sanskrit

                                                    SCIENCE
The Science stream in Kamrup College, Chamata has been newly introduced
in 2022 with five departments keeping up with the demands of the area for
undergraduate science education. The Science stream offers a dynamic
study environment filled with countless opportunities and prospects to
explore. The departments under Science Stream are-
    • Botany       • Chemistry       • Mathematics
    • Physics      • Zoology
